name: Tag
summary: Compact value label with an optional named remove action whose state update remains owned by the consuming target.

anatomy.name: root
anatomy.description: Inline wrapper for one category, filter, or selected value.

anatomy.name: remove
anatomy.description: Optional native button that requests removal.

anatomy.name: removeIndicator
anatomy.description: Generated fixed X indicator using Lucide geometry.

states.name: default
states.description: Resting tag and optional remove action.

states.name: removeHover
states.description: Pointer hover on the remove action.

states.name: removeFocusVisible
states.description: Keyboard focus on the remove action.

states.name: removeDisabled
states.description: Unavailable remove action while the value remains visible.

behavior.name: removeRequest
behavior.description: The native button emits a removal request; the consuming target updates application state and removes the Tag.

behavior.name: removalAnnouncement
behavior.description: When removal changes an editable list or active filters, the consuming target announces the result in its contextual live region.

behavior.name: nativeDisabled
behavior.description: A temporarily unavailable remove action uses native disabled behavior without hiding the current value.

properties.name: label
properties.description: Visible category, filter, or selected value.

properties.name: removeAction
properties.description: Optional native button that requests removal of the represented value.

properties.name: removeLabel
properties.description: Accessible name for the optional remove action, including the value being removed.

properties.name: removalDisabled
properties.description: Temporarily disables the optional native remove button.

accessibility: Use a native type="button" remove action and include the represented value in its aria-label.
Do not make the entire Tag interactive when only removal is available.
Keep the visible value readable and let the consuming target announce removal from an editable list or filter set.
Use Badge for passive status and Link when activating the label should navigate.

web.notes: Implemented by class composition in components/css/primitives.css; the consumer owns the state update requested by the remove button.

shopify.notes: Shopify may use a named button for client-owned filters or a target-native link when removal is navigation.
